intro.h2: More room and more storage from the same kitchen
paragraphs: Sam's Cabinets Inc. is a cabinet maker offering kitchen cabinets in Salisbury, North Carolina. Customers know the business through Sam and Gail. Gail designs the kitchens, and the goal is a room that works better than the one you have now.

Lynn H. remodeled a 90 year old mill house and expected to put new cabinets in the same old layout. Gail redesigned the space instead, gave her several options to choose from and found much more working room and storage. Linn L. says Gail and Sam know what they are doing, and another customer sums up the job as on time, professional, excellent work.

services.h2: Kitchen cabinets in Salisbury, designed and built

items.name: Kitchen design by Gail
items.blurb: You do not have to keep the old layout. Gail looks at the whole room and redesigns the space, so the new kitchen can give you more working room and storage. Lynn H. says Gail gave her several options to choose from and that they couldn't be happier.

process.h2: How your new kitchen comes together

steps.title: Call to start
steps.text: Call (704) 754-0096 Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM or Saturday morning, and tell Sam and Gail about your kitchen.

steps.title: Gail designs the space
steps.text: Gail looks at the room as a whole, not just the old cabinet layout, to find more working room and storage.

steps.title: Choose your option
steps.text: Review the design options Gail puts together and pick the layout, cabinet style and finishes that suit your home.

steps.title: Your cabinets are made
steps.text: Your cabinets are made for the layout you chose. Customers describe the work as on time, professional and excellent.

service_area.text: Sam's Cabinets Inc. is listed in Salisbury, North Carolina. The Google listing does not show a street address or a list of towns, so if you are not sure whether your home is in the area, call (704) 754-0096 on a weekday between 8 AM and 5 PM or on Saturday morning. Tell Sam and Gail where you live and what you want to change in your kitchen.

items.q: Do I have to keep my old kitchen layout?
items.a: No. Lynn H. expected to replace her old cabinets in the same layout, but Gail redesigned the space and gave her much more working room and storage. Gail also offered several options to choose from. Bring your measurements and a list of what bothers you about your kitchen today.

items.q: Can you work in an older home?
items.a: Yes. One of Gail's kitchen designs was for a 90 year old mill house that was being remodeled. The owner says she had no idea her kitchen could be so wonderful. Older homes often have odd room sizes, so call to talk through your space and what you want.

Sam's Cabinets Inc. is open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM and Saturday from 8 AM to 12 PM, and closed on Sunday. Saturday mornings are a good time to call if you work during the week and want to talk through a kitchen project.

Sam's Cabinets Inc. is listed in Salisbury, North Carolina. The Google listing does not show a street address, so please call (704) 754-0096 before you plan a visit. Sam and Gail can tell you where to find them and whether your home is in their area.

items.q: How do I get in touch?
items.a: Call Sam's Cabinets Inc. at (704) 754-0096 during business hours or email ssplus8@carolina.rr.com. Tell Sam and Gail about your kitchen, the age of your house and what you would like to change, and they can explain how they would approach the design.

final_cta.h2: Let's design a kitchen that works better
final_cta.text: Call Sam and Gail to talk through your kitchen and your options.
